headline: Check Local Safari Availability for Guided Loch Excursions
reservation: Access to the loch shore is generally open, but guided boat safaris require advance booking directly with local operators. Operating schedules vary significantly by season; confirm availability and departure times with Visit Aberfeldy or the safari provider before arrival.

days.title: Historical Waters of Loch Tay

stops.name: Loch Tay
stops.detail: Discover the story of the loch through a guided safari to experience the area's natural beauty and heritage from the water.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for local transfers around the loch head; conditions vary by narrow road access
days.note: Pacing is a suggestion; boat departures are fixed and weather dependent

intel.title: Village Access
intel.text: Parking is typically available in the nearby villages of Kenmore or Aberfeldy. Specific parking capacity at the loch-side departure points is not documented in available evidence.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Cellular signal strength around the loch shore and on the water is unverified. Download offline maps and confirm booking details before leaving the gateway towns.

intel.title: Local Supply
intel.text: Fuel availability immediately at the loch shore is not specified. Verify fuel levels in Aberfeldy or larger nearby settlements before exploring the rural perimeter.

intel.title: Safari Schedules
intel.text: Boat safaris operate on specific schedules that may change based on demand and weather. Arrive at least twenty minutes before your booked departure to allow for boarding.

intel.title: Water Access
intel.text: Public access points are available, though boat-based exploration is recommended to reach deeper historical sites. Check for local notices regarding water safety and environmental protection.

plan.arrival: First two hours: Pickup rental in a major city, travel to Aberfeldy for supplies, and check-in at your local accommodation near Kenmore.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for main roads; check for narrow-road restrictions if driving larger RVs.
plan.goldenHour: Kenmore waterfront at sunset provides scenic views, though timing varies by season.
